create_LUTSchema: create a LUTSchema instance to define a lookup table schema for Caffe2 operator runtime records
load_caffe2_op: load a Caffe2 operator definition into a LUTSchema record with input shapes and data types
set_val_LUTSchema: set a value for a specific key in the LUTSchema record dictionary
get_val_LUTSchema: get the value of a specific key from the LUTSchema record dictionary
load_from_json_LUTSchema: load LUTSchema record values from a JSON string or dictionary input
